subject.title: fix(agents): repair orphaned tool_use pairs on compaction prune path

question: Should compaction use the same `erroredAssistantResultPolicy: "drop"` behavior as prompt-send replay for aborted assistant tool-call turns, accepting loss of the incomplete aborted turn instead of synthesizing a result?
rationale: The code change is narrow and appears correct, but the remaining choice is policy: dropping the aborted turn avoids invalid transcripts and fabricated results, while synthesizing could preserve more context but may misrepresent tool execution state.

options.title: Accept drop policy
options.body: Merge after review, treating aborted tool-call turns as incomplete state that should be removed before compaction summarization.

options.title: Require synthetic recovery
options.body: Ask the contributor to replace the drop behavior with an explicit synthetic or ambiguous-result policy and matching tests before merge.

options.title: Pause for broader recovery design
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want a larger session-recovery design that covers compaction, replay, doctor, and provider-specific behavior together.

recommendation.title: Accept drop policy
recommendation.body: Merge after review, treating aborted tool-call turns as incomplete state that should be removed before compaction summarization.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest feature-history owner for the shared transcript repair helper and related session-state policy that this PR extends into compaction.
